GenAiFunction.description: Use this when the customer reports an outage or asks whether a service is down, slow, or being worked on — for example "is my internet down", "why is my TV out", or checking network status in their area. Shows a service-health board with an overall banner, per-service status rows, the affected area, an estimated restore time, and a notify-me action.
GenAiFunction.masterLabel: ASA Technology, Media & Comms · Service Status
GenAiFunction.progressIndicatorMessage: Checking service status in your area
